text:
PALETTE ARCHITECTURE was founded in 2010 and has branches in New York and Los Angeles. Our work includes hospitality, education, multi-family, and custom residential projects. The work ranges in scale from new buildings and facade recladdings to facility modernizations and interior fitouts. Current work includes new construction and adaptive reuse for multi-family reidential buildings, large-scale fitness facilities, and single-family speculative projects in the Hudson Valley.
We are looking for an intermediate architect to join our growing team. You will work in a collaborative, design-focused studio culture where you learn through hands-on collaboration. We are looking for a highly motivated individual eager to engage in critical thinking, design, construction documents, and construction administration. We value an organized, pro-active architect that is capable of multi-tasking and taking projects through to completion. You will work closely with partners, but also be responsible for leading projects and teams.
Qualifications:
Applicants should include cover letters with salary requirements, academic and professional work samples, and up to 3 references. Please email information to [email protected] with "Intermediate Architect" as the subject.
